page.title: Telegram
page.notConfigured: Telegram is not set up yet. An admin has to add the bot first.
page.intro: Link your Telegram account with {bot} to get event updates there too.
page.waiting: Telegram opens. Tap “Start” there and your account is linked.
page.turnOn: Turn Telegram on or off under Profile › Notifications.
page.blocked: The bot could not reach you last time, it was probably blocked. Link again to get messages.
admin.notConfigured: Not set up yet. Create a bot with /newbot at @BotFather in Telegram, set the token as MATCHDESK_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and restart Matchdesk.
admin.test: Send a test message to my Telegram
admin.linkFirst: Link your own account under Telegram in the menu to send a test message.
admin.testOk: Test message is on its way.
